welcome.title: An online teaching platform for admins, teachers and students.
welcome.subtitle: Browse courses, request enrollment, publish PDF materials, and keep every action auditable.
welcome.point1: Role-based access control with verified 403 boundaries
welcome.point3: PDF materials served only to approved students

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Students can self-register; teachers need an invite code.
register.name: Full name
register.inviteHint: Ask an administrator for a teacher invite code.
register.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

courses.title: Course catalog
courses.subtitle: All published courses. Materials are visible after enrollment is approved.
courses.emptyBody: Once teachers publish courses they will appear here.

course.noMaterialsBody: The teacher has not uploaded any PDF material.
course.lockedBody: Only approved students, the teacher and administrators can view the materials.
course.pendingNote: Your request is waiting for teacher approval.
course.enrolledNote: You are enrolled in this course.
course.rejectedNote: Your request was rejected. You can apply again.
course.closedNote: This course is no longer accepting enrollment.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the API. Is the backend running on :8000?
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.INVALID_INVITE_CODE: That invite code is not valid.
errors.INVITE_CODE_REQUIRED: A teacher invite code is required.
errors.ACCOUNT_EXISTS: This email or university ID is already registered.
errors.INVALID_TRANSITION: This request conflicts with the current enrollment state.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: The student is already a member of this course.
errors.NOT_COURSE_MEMBER: Only course members can access this.
errors.ENROLLMENT_CLOSED: Enrollment is closed for this course.
errors.SUPABASE_KEY_INVALID: The backend cannot reach Supabase — its service key is invalid or was rotated.
errors.SERVER_MISCONFIGURED: The backend is misconfigured. Check its logs and environment variables.

interview.title: Interview Mastery
interview.subtitle: Practice deliberately, review your answers, and build confidence one step at a time.
interview.mockNotice: Frontend-only demo: all records stay in this browser. No backend or AI service is called.
interview.loadErrorTitle: Local demo data could not be loaded
interview.clearAllMessage: This permanently removes all mock resumes, reports, question sets, interviews, and review items from this browser.
interview.mockErrorArmed: The next mock AI action will fail. No real API will be called.

dashboard.title: Your interview practice, in one place.
dashboard.description: A private, independent workspace for resume feedback, question practice, mock interviews, and review.
dashboard.resumeAssessmentBody: Get structured feedback and actionable edits for a target role.
dashboard.resumeQuestionsBody: Prepare for behavioral, project, technical, and pressure questions.
dashboard.mockInterviewBody: Run a guided text interview with a final scorecard.
dashboard.wrongAnswerReviewBody: Revisit weak answers and practice variations.
dashboard.noActivityBody: Start with a resume assessment or configure a mock interview.
dashboard.clearHint: Use clear data to exercise empty states; restore demo data to start over.

resume.assessmentDescription: Review the extracted text, choose a target role, then generate a structured mock report.
resume.jobDescriptionPlaceholder: Paste the relevant requirements for a more targeted review.
resume.resumeTextPlaceholder: Paste your resume text here. The mock parser does not upload files or call a service.
resume.chooseFile: Choose a PDF or DOCX file
resume.fileLimit: Maximum 10 MiB. File parsing is simulated locally for this mock.
resume.noResumesBody: Paste or upload a resume to create your first local mock record.
resume.privacyBody: This demo keeps text only in this browser's local storage. It never uploads your resume or calls an AI service.
resume.consent: I understand this is a local mock assessment.
resume.emptyReport: Choose a saved resume and generate an assessment.
resume.assessmentSuccess: Mock assessment generated and saved locally.

questions.title: Prepare for questions your resume may invite.
questions.description: Generate a mock question set from a saved resume or a project excerpt.
questions.experiencePlaceholder: Paste a project or experience excerpt (at least 30 characters).
questions.noQuestionSetsBody: Choose a resume or paste an experience excerpt to generate a practice set.
questions.deleteSetMessage: The set and its linked review items will be removed from local mock data.

config.title: Configure your interview
config.description: Set a role and format. The interview is a local scripted simulation, not a real AI conversation.
config.questionRange: Choose 4–12 interviewer questions, including your introduction.
config.privacy: This mock uses only browser-local data. Nothing is sent to a server.
config.consent: I understand and want to start the local mock interview.
config.validation: Enter a target role and confirm the mock notice.
config.createError: Could not create the mock interview. Try again.

conversation.question: Question {count} of {total}
conversation.answerPlaceholder: Type your answer. Your local response is saved in this browser.
conversation.pausedBody: Your current question and answers are stored locally. Resume when you are ready.
conversation.redoNotice: You are re-answering the previous question. The superseded answer remains in history but is excluded from scoring.
conversation.candidatePrompt: You may ask one question, or skip this part and finish.
conversation.guideBody: Use a real example, make your individual contribution clear, and explain how you verified the result.
conversation.notFound: This mock interview could not be found.
conversation.loadError: Unable to load the local interview.
conversation.endConfirmBody: A local scorecard will be generated from the answers so far. The report will be marked partial if you finish early.
conversation.finishError: The mock review could not be generated. Your answers are preserved; retry the review.

report.title: Your practice scorecard
report.description: Use this mock feedback as a prompt for reflection, not as a hiring decision.
report.reviewAdded: Weak answers are available in Wrong-answer review.
report.empty: This interview has not been completed yet.
report.deleteBody: This removes the interview and its automatically linked review items from local mock data.

review.title: Turn weak answers into focused practice.
review.description: Review saved mock items, retry an answer, and update your own mastery status.
review.question: Question
review.questionPlaceholder: Write the question you want to practice.
review.manualAdded: Question added to local review data.
review.emptyBody: Mark a question for review, finish a mock interview, or add one yourself.
review.deleteBody: This removes the item and its practice attempts from local mock data.

errors.INTERVIEW_AI_UNAVAILABLE: Mock AI is temporarily unavailable. Your input is preserved; try again.
errors.INTERVIEW_TEXT_TOO_SHORT: The text is too short. Add more detail and try again.
errors.INTERVIEW_TEXT_TOO_LONG: The text exceeds the mock limit. Shorten it and try again.
errors.INTERVIEW_ANSWER_INVALID: Check the answer and try again.
errors.INTERVIEW_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND: This local mock item could not be found.
errors.INTERVIEW_SESSION_STATE_INVALID: This action is not available in the current interview state.
errors.MOCK_DATA_INVALID: Local mock data could not be read. Restore the demo data to continue.
errors.BROWSER_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Browser storage is unavailable, so mock data cannot be saved.
errors.UNKNOWN: The operation failed. Please try again.
